# LLM Evaluation Portfolio

An applied research and demonstration portfolio about structured, reproducible evaluation of large language model outputs. It uses task-specific rubrics, controlled stress tests, and cross-case analysis to examine citation support, response quality, and adversarial resilience, while documenting methodology and limitations. It is not a representative benchmark or production evaluation system.

- Citation Verification: https://github.com/Dineshwev/LLM-Evaluation-Benchmarks/blob/main/llm-evaluation-portfolio/citation-verification/README.md
- LLM Response Evaluation: https://github.com/Dineshwev/LLM-Evaluation-Benchmarks/blob/main/llm-evaluation-portfolio/llm-response-evaluation/README.md
- Adversarial Testing: https://github.com/Dineshwev/LLM-Evaluation-Benchmarks/blob/main/llm-evaluation-portfolio/adversarial-testing/README.md
- Methodology: https://github.com/Dineshwev/LLM-Evaluation-Benchmarks/blob/main/llm-evaluation-portfolio/methodology/README.md
